title: ot-cres: optimal-transport-based cell resampling for negative event weights
description:
ot-cres is the code accompanying the paper Optimal-Transport-Based Cell Resampling for Negative and Pathological Event Weights (arXiv:2607.08723, hep-ph). It implements cell resampling of negatively weighted Monte Carlo events: each negative-weight event seeds a cell that grows to include its nearest neighbours in a metric space until the summed weight is positive, and the weights in the cell are then rescaled to be non-negative while preserving the total cross section.

The repository provides: (1) preprocessing of MadGraph/Pythia .root and .hepmc samples into per-event particle arrays at the hard-process, showered and hadron levels; (2) vantage-point-tree construction using the Energy Mover's Distance (EMD) with configurable β; (3) cell reweighting with the vp-tree or by brute force from a precomputed distance matrix; (4) computation of spectral EMD (SEMD) distance matrices with SPECTER/JAX; (5) the Cross-Section Mover's Distance (XMD), an unbinned optimal-transport measure of the bias introduced by reweighting; and (6) plotting notebooks for the Z+jets and t̄t studies in the paper. A synthetic-data example (scripts/examples/run_toy_example.sh) exercises the full chain in a few seconds without access to the original samples.
